parent.title: Which React router to adopt in 2026: a decision framework for a client-rendered admin SPA

siblings.title: Type-Safe Routing & Typed Search-Param State in React (2026)
siblings.summary: TanStack Router is the only router with typed, schema-validated search-param state end to end — the decisive edge for a filter-heavy admin console, at the cost of advanced-type complexity.

siblings.title: Router-driven data loading in React (2026): who owns the cache?
siblings.summary: For a CSR-only admin SPA on a REST/OpenAPI backend, let a query library own the cache and keep the router thin — framework loaders only pay off with SSR.

siblings.title: Library-mode router vs meta-framework (and RSC) for a React 19 admin SPA in 2026
siblings.summary: For an auth-gated internal admin SPA, a standalone router on Vite is still a first-class 2026 choice; RSC and meta-frameworks solve problems this app doesn't have.

siblings.title: Migration Effort & Lock-In: Choosing a React Router in 2026
siblings.summary: Already on React Router? Staying is near-drop-in. Greenfield SPA? The lock-in and churn math tilts toward TanStack Router.

sources.title: React Router v7 vs TanStack Router (2026) — pkgpulse
sources.claim: React Router v7 is the safer default with the biggest ecosystem and least migration friction; TanStack Router wins for TypeScript-first client-heavy SPAs with typed search params; RRv7's advanced type safety mostly needs framework mode.

sources.title: TanStack Router — Comparison / feature matrix
sources.claim: Feature matrix: TanStack Router offers full type-safe path and search params in SPA mode; React Router partial; Next.js limited and file-based only with no code-based routes.

sources.title: molefrog/wouter — GitHub
sources.claim: Wouter is a ~2.2KB minimalist hooks-based router for React and Preact with familiar Route/Link/Switch components and an optional top-level Router.

sources.title: React Router v8 — remix.run blog
sources.claim: React Router v8 shipped in June 2026, the first major since the project adopted open governance; the library has a 12-year history powering billions of downloads.

sources.title: React Router 8 GA — stackmaven news
sources.claim: React Router moved to a yearly major release cadence with open governance, targeting v9 around May 2027 aligned to Node 22 EOL, raising baseline to Node 22 and ESM.

sources.title: TanStack Router — official site
sources.claim: @tanstack/react-router has over 12.7M weekly npm downloads and is the fastest-growing router; a May 2026 npm supply-chain attack briefly compromised 42 @tanstack/* packages before recovery.

sources.title: Next.js App Router — Single-Page Applications guide
sources.claim: Next.js App Router can build SPAs and static exports with instant client transitions, but is server-first by design; syncing client-side navigation requires window.history integration.

sources.title: React Router v7 modes — LogRocket
sources.claim: React Router v7 has three additive modes: declarative (basic SPA routing), data (loaders/actions), and framework (successor to Remix v2, a full-stack framework like Next.js); more features cost architectural control.

sources.title: TanStack Router — official site
sources.claim: TanStack Router reached stable v1.0.0 in December 2023 and is used in production across SPAs, dashboards and internal tools.
